itens.titulo: Dólar sobe 0,85% e fecha a R$ 5,225; Ibovespa cai 0,26%
itens.descricao: Dólar sobe 0,85% e fecha a R$ 5,225; Ibovespa cai 0,26% Poder360
trechos: Dólar sobe 0,85% e fecha a R$ 5,225; Ibovespa cai 0,26% O mercado reagiu à divulgação da pesquisa Quaest para presidente da República e ao Boletim Focus, do Banco Central O dólar subiu 0,85% e fechou a R$ 5,225 nesta 2ª feira (28.set.2026).
O Ibovespa caiu 0,26% e foi a 182.991,13 pontos.

Os mercados reagiram à pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta 2ª feira (28.set), que mostra o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) empatado com o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) nas intenções de voto para o 2º turno das eleições presidenciais.
A Quaest entrevistou 2.004 eleitores de 24 a 27 de setembro de 2026.
A pesquisa tem nível de confiança de 95% e margem de erro de 2 pontos percentuais.
Foi registrada no Tribunal Superior Eleitoral sob o número BR-06520/2026.
O levantamento custou R$ 314.628.
As instituições financeiras elevaram de 4,92% para 4,99% a projeção para a inflação em 2026, segundo o documento.

itens.titulo: Petróleo encosta em US$ 109 e faz Prio (PRIO3), Petrobras (PETR4) e petroleiras saltarem até 4%
itens.descricao: Petróleo encosta em US$ 109 e faz Prio (PRIO3), Petrobras (PETR4) e petroleiras saltarem até 4% suno.com.br
trechos: Petróleo encosta em US$ 109 e faz Prio (PRIO3), Petrobras (PETR4) e petroleiras saltarem até 4% O petróleo chegou perto de US$ 109 por barril e colocou as empresas do setor entre as maiores altas da B3 nesta segunda-feira (28).
Prio (PRIO3), Petrobras (PETR3; PETR4), Brava Energia (BRAV3) e PetroReconcavo (RECV3) avançaram em uma sessão marcada pelo aumento das tensões no Oriente Médio.
Após o encerramento do pregão, o Status Invest indicava alta de 3,91% para a Prio, a R$ 61,67.
A PetroReconcavo subiu 4,39%, a R$ 10,93, enquanto a Brava Energia avançou 3,16%, para R$ 17,96.
Na Petrobras, as ações ordinárias PETR3 ganharam 2,17%, a R$ 54,19, e as preferenciais PETR4 subiram 1,88%, a R$ 48,89, segundo os valores apresentados pelo Status Invest após o pregão.
O contrato do petróleo Brent para novembro, próximo do vencimento, chegou a US$ 108,83 por barril na máxima do dia, com valorização superior a 4%.
Antes do conflito, aproximadamente 20% da oferta mundial da commodity passava pelo Estreito de Ormuz, segundo informações da Reuters.
Ao longo da sessão, o Brent devolveu parte dos ganhos e voltou para perto de US$ 105 por barril.

itens.titulo: Amazon (AMZN) vs. Alibaba (BABA): Which AI Bet Is Starting to Pay Off?
itens.descricao: Amazon (AMZN) vs. Alibaba (BABA): Which AI Bet Is Starting to Pay Off? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Amazon is trading at about 23.6x forward earnings, compared with roughly 17.9x for Alibaba.
AWS revenue jumped by a solid 37% year over year in the second quarter to $42.2 billion, its fastest growth in 18 quarters.
Amazon also said its AI business within AWS had surpassed an annual run rate of $25 billion, with AI and custom chips each growing at triple-digit rates.
Amazon's heavy AI spending has pushed free cash flow into negative territory, with the company raising its 2026 capital spending expectations to around a staggering $220 billion.
Its AI Cloud and Compute Services business grew 45% year over year in the June quarter to roughly $7.1 billion, while AI-related product revenue has continued to grow at triple-digit rates.

itens.titulo: Strive Crosses 27,000 BTC After $94.5 Million Bitcoin Purchase
itens.descricao: Strive Crosses 27,000 BTC After $94.5 Million Bitcoin Purchase Yahoo Finance
trechos: Strive (NASDAQ: $ASST) bought 1,107 bitcoin for approximately $94.5 million last week, pushing its total holdings to 27,462 BTC, according to a Form 8-K filed Monday with the U.S.
The Dallas-based asset manager made the purchases between September 21 and September 25 at an average price of $85,396 per coin, including fees.
The pace marked a slowdown from the prior week, when Strive added 1,355 bitcoin, based on its previous filings.
Strive's perpetual preferred stock, known as SATA, supplied 85% of the capital raised for the purchase.
Warrant exercises generated an additional $12.4 million.

A 469-bitcoin purchase earlier this month that brought holdings to an even 25,000 coins was paid for entirely with the preferred stock, while a $109 million purchase in early September split funding 70/30 between SATA and common stock.
Strive remains the fifth-largest public bitcoin holder, trailing Strategy (NASDAQ: $MSTR), Twenty One Capital, Metaplanet and MARA (NASDAQ: $MARA), according to Bitcoin Treasuries data.
Closing the gap with fourth-place Twenty One, which holds 43,514 BTC, would require roughly 16,050 more coins by year-end — about 1,235 bitcoin a week.

itens.titulo: A Look Back at General Industrial Machinery Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: 3M (NYSE:MMM) Vs The Rest Of The Pack
itens.descricao: A Look Back at General Industrial Machinery Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: 3M (NYSE:MMM) Vs The Rest Of The Pack Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: A Look Back at General Industrial Machinery Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: 3M (NYSE:MMM) Vs The Rest Of The Pack Let's dig into the relative performance of 3M (NYSE:MMM) and its peers as we unravel the now-completed Q2 general industrial machinery earnings season.
The 12 general industrial machinery stocks we track reported a strong Q2.
As a group, revenues beat analysts' consensus estimates by 2.6% while next quarter's revenue guidance was 3.3% below.
On average, they are down 6.2% since the latest earnings results.
3M (NYSE:MMM) Producers of the first asthma inhaler, 3M Company (NYSE:MMM) is a global conglomerate known for products in industries like healthcare, safety, electronics, and consumer goods.
3M reported revenues of $6.5 billion, up 5.6% year on year.
This print exceeded analysts' expectations by 1.5%.
Interestingly, the stock is up 6% since reporting and currently trades at $168.69.
